plan.title: Customer Support Executive Onboarding Plan
plan.summary: Structured onboarding plan for a beginner Customer Support Executive focusing on essential responsibilities including verification, case handling, complaint management, evidence recording, refund protocol, and escalation procedures.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must open a case for each new enquiry, record the shipment ID and classify the issue before advising the customer. Related follow-ups must link to the existing case.
items.learning_objective: Learn to open and classify customer cases accurately to ensure proper tracking and handling of enquiries.
items.practical_activity: Practice opening sample customer cases with various enquiry types, recording shipment IDs, and linking follow-ups.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must complete approved requester verification before disclosing protected shipment details, following POL-06. A failed verification permits only general public guidance.
items.learning_objective: Understand and apply the requester verification process to protect shipment details according to POL-06.
items.practical_activity: Role-play verification scenarios to practice distinguishing verified requesters from non-verified.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must check the latest recorded shipment event and applicable SOP before promising a next step. Missing tracking information must be described as unconfirmed.
items.learning_objective: Learn to verify latest shipment status and applicable SOP to provide accurate information and avoid unconfirmed promises.
items.practical_activity: Analyze shipment records and SOPs to determine appropriate responses for different tracking statuses.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must acknowledge a complaint within 2 working hours of receipt and provide the case reference and next update time. Critical incidents follow POL-09 instead of this routine target.
items.learning_objective: Ensure prompt acknowledgement of complaints with clear communication of case references and update timelines.
items.practical_activity: Simulate receiving complaints and crafting timely acknowledgment messages including necessary details.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must record the resolution, supporting evidence and customer notification before closure. Lack of customer response alone must not be recorded as successful delivery.
items.learning_objective: Master the procedure to document resolutions thoroughly including evidence and customer notifications before closing cases.
items.practical_activity: Review case studies to identify proper closure documentation and practice completing closure reports.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must send refund requests to the Returns Specialist and must not promise eligibility, amount or payment date before approval under SOP-14 and SOP-16.
items.learning_objective: Understand the refund process and limits of authority for promising refunds, ensuring compliance with SOP-14 and SOP-16.
items.practical_activity: Practice preparing refund requests and role-playing communication avoiding unauthorized promises.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive must escalate a routine case still unresolved after 1 working day to the Operations Manager with actions taken and the outstanding decision.
items.learning_objective: Learn to identify cases requiring escalation and prepare clear summaries for the Operations Manager.
items.practical_activity: Simulate unresolved case scenarios and draft escalation communications.

items.source_quote: The Customer Support Executive may propose an FAQ clarification after identifying repeated confusion, subject to owner review before publication.
items.learning_objective: Develop skills to identify frequent customer confusion and suggest FAQ improvements effectively.
items.practical_activity: Review past cases to find patterns of confusion and draft potential FAQ clarifications for review.
